messages:
marta: Quick sync — after the prefetch-window change in PR #4123 I saw a small hit-rate dip on canary. Not a full regression but a ~3-4% drop for long-tail prefixes. Anyone else?

jason: saw the alert, digging. which canary cluster? node-pool-c2?

marta: yes node-pool-c2, region-us-west2. Spike started ~23:20 UTC. evictions up, fragmentation metric ticked.

liam: I can run a short smoke bench. what's the exact command you used?

marta: used the dev harness with prefix sampling: ``./tools/run_kv_bench --workload=prefix --prefix-sample=150k --dur=90 --concurrency=16``. results attached below (paste): hit_rate: 91.6% -> baseline 95.8% ; evictions/sec doubled.

jason: thanks. can you also capture the slot-occupancy histogram and the LRU age distribution? that will tell if older entries are being pushed out.

marta: good call. two extra flags: ``--emit-slot-hist --emit-lru-age``. ran locally, will upload to the perf bucket.

perf-bot: [perf-check] Canary node-pool-c2: baseline window=32 -> new window=48. Evictions: 120/s -> 265/s. KV_fragmentation_p75: 0.12 -> 0.19.

sara: FYI oncall: we have capacity to run canary runs tonight until 01:00 UTC. prefer liam/jason to schedule before then. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam: I'll kick off a controlled run on one canary (c2-11) in 5m with the extra emits. will also capture tcpdump and pprof. ping me if you want the raw traces.

marta: thx. also pinging @jason for a quick CR look on the prefetch-window diff — it's small but touches rebalance logic, want eyes before revert.

jason: on it, will glance now.

liam: initial run done (90s). quick numbers: hit_rate 92.1%, evictions 248/s, slot_frag p90=0.18. attaching short log snippet: ``KV: slots=768k, avg_slot_fill=0.64, reclaim_iters=3``

marta: interesting — reclaim_iters up post-change. might be due to slightly denser slot packing. can we try lowering prefetch-window by 8 to see delta?

jason: I'll draft a patch for `PREFETCH_WINDOW=40` and push a canary build. if that moves hit-rate back up we'll consider a targeted rollback only for window param.

sara: schedule the canary and leave a note in incidents/inc-2026-02-kv-prefetch. ops will hold scaling.

liam: pushed results and traces to gs://redwood-perf/canary/1869004321/ . included pprof, slot histogram PNG, and the run command.

marta: awesome. next steps: jason pushes the small window tweak, liam re-runs the same bench, we compare histograms and hit-rate delta. if >2% improvement we keep tweak; else revert full PR. i'll update thread when we have numbers. :thumbsup:

jason: patch up in branch `prefetch/window-40` and CI pass. kicking canary build now.

marta: thanks all. if anyone sees anomalies in adjacent metrics (latency tail, batching), flag here.

perf-bot: [ci] build prefeth/window-40 deployed to canary-c2-11 at 1869004520.

liam: running the controlled bench on the new build now. will post back in ~2m.

marta: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

liam: final run complete. numbers: hit_rate 95.1% (baseline 95.8), evictions 130/s, slot_frag p90=0.13. reclaim_iters back to 1-2. Looks close to baseline.

jason: that's encouraging. I'll open a small revert/tweak PR to adjust default to 40 and land a follow-up that documents tradeoffs.

marta: merge the tweak + add a perf test into the CI harness to catch this window sensitivity. tagging this as resolved for now, will follow up with perf dashboard update.

sara: noted in incident page and closing oncall window. great work everyone. :white_check_mark:
